APPROVE

The prerequisite loop, with its nested `if`/`break`/`if` that sat inside the outer loop, moves verbatim into a private static helper called at the same point with the same arguments. That removes roughly 8 points of cognitive complexity from `AppendMakeRecipes` and leaves behaviour unchanged. I could not see the file, so I assumed the parameter types match the original declarations, which the diff does not confirm.
